Inference under causal attention; saves repeated calculation while adding cache storage; profile before choosing optimization.
Exact dense attention IO optimization; not fewer attention interactions, not model-weight compression or guaranteed speed on all devices.
Model/API acceptance limit differs from task-specific effective utilization. No numerical context guarantee.
Length cap, not guaranteed output count or context quality. Original v4.57.1 method tested on stubs; no model generation.
PI scaling is a mechanism, not automatic guarantee of usable longer-context quality; original PI adaptation includes fine-tuning.
Direct locality differs from theoretical stacked receptive field; transmission/retrieval is not guaranteed.
Fewer-bit weight storage motivation; total format metadata/activation requirements and hardware-specific performance remain separate.
Mechanism and deployment motivation, not preservation of all knowledge/quality or universal speed guarantee.
Human comparisons can train RM; PPO is one algorithm rather than definition of human feedback. Repo templates are not recruited human labelers.
Specifically clipped PPO variant used by chapter; clipping is surrogate training objective, not quality scaling, fixed KL reference or hard bound on every policy movement.
Preference-trained scalar RM in this chapter/RLHF; score is learned preference estimate, not correctness oracle or universal definition of all reward signals.
Stochastic language/card policies; RL also permits deterministic policies, not contradicted by this specified example.
One-step chapter card expected score; general sequential value estimates remaining return and baseline need not be a separate network.
